META.TITLE: Biab nagels in Capelle aan den IJssel | Biab Nailstudio in Capelle aan den IJssel
META.CONTENT: Looking for a Nagelstudio in Capelle aan den IJssel? This is the right place if you want a high quality in your treatments!!! Strength nails, healthy, always perfect with a nice natural appearance. You can come for your TheGelBottle Biab Treatment, GelPolish, GelNails, extensions nails, (Not acrylic) , a natural manicure, and even for your pedicure!!! Don’t lose your opportunity to get an elegant, shiny, clean NailArt design, and a keep your nails in a pretty and healthy condition! Do you have any allergies to this kind of products? I have a possible solution! with the new Biab from The Gel Bottle HEMA FREE!

TREATMENTS.name: Biab Treatment
TREATMENTS.description: The GelBottle Inc™ BIAB is a thicker consistency gel, chip-resistant which helps to harden your natural nails while you wear it and offer extreme long lasting shine. BIAB tends to last around three to four weeks – sometimes longer.
TREATMENTS.title: Biab Nailstudio in Capelle aan den iJssel

TREATMENTS.name: GelPolish
TREATMENTS.description: The GelPolish Colour is applied with the Biab Rubber Base Coat underneath to give extra strength to flaky, brittle, thin or splitting nails. Treatments includes manicure always. GelPolish tends to last around two to three weeks – sometimes longer.

TREATMENTS.name: Nail Polish CND Vinylux
TREATMENTS.description: CND VINYLUX™ Long Wear Polish Colour finished with top coat shine which makes it way more chip-resistant than your average nail polish. It tends to last at least a week. Then you can remove it with standard nail polish remover.

TREATMENTS.name: Manicure E-File
TREATMENTS.description: The E-file manicure means I perform on dry skin using different E-file bits to push back and exfoliate the dead skin which gives us a more clean and polished look. Then your nails are ready to receive the treatment you are wanting!

TREATMENTS.name: Toenails Color
TREATMENTS.description: Color on toenails (the treatment includes cuticles removal and shape toenails)

TREATMENTS.name: Nail Repair
TREATMENTS.description: Fixing nails just before your treatment or when you come to me to fix one. Time and price will depend on the condition of the nail. If it happend due to a defect in the treatment itself then it will be free of charge.
